templates.why_chosen: High-confidence three-panel exemplar spanning abstraction to reality: panel (a) floorplans host, switch and memory chassis through named upstream and downstream ports, panel (b) photographs the real testbed, and panel (c) exposes the switch's crossbar fabric.
templates.what_to_learn: Ground an abstract port-to-port floorplan with a photo of the real evaluated testbed so readers trust the abstraction, then zoom into the one internal datapath that matters, virtual lane to crossbar, in a third panel; do not rely on greyscale alone to separate roles as this figure's recorded weakness does.
